question: I'm a CS junior. I want to take 15-213 (Section 3: Mon/Wed 11:30–12:45) and 15-440 (Distributed Systems, Section 3: Tue/Sun 08:30–09:45) simultaneously in Fall 2025. Is there a schedule conflict between these two sections?
expected_answer: No — 15-213 Section 3 meets Monday and Wednesday 11:30–12:45, while 15-440 Section 3 meets Tuesday and Sunday 08:30–09:45. These courses share no common meeting days or times.
reasoning_type: No-conflict verification for non-overlapping weekday sections
common_mistake: Checking only days without times; assuming two different courses must conflict if both are heavy CS courses
needs_verification: Confirm P-004 meets prerequisites for both courses (15-122 for 15-213; advanced prereqs for 15-440)
